selection_rationale: Highest nested-CV ROC-AUC: Logistic Regression (0.9950 ± 0.0019 SE). Candidates within one standard error of that value (Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (RBF)) were treated as statistically indistinguishable; among them the one with the lowest mean CV Brier score (best probability quality) was chosen, with model simplicity as the final tie-break. Selected: Support Vector Machine (RBF) (CV ROC-AUC 0.9948, CV Brier 0.0214, CV recall 0.9500). The held-out test set was not used.
selection_rule: max nested-CV ROC-AUC; within-1-SE pool -> min CV Brier; then simplicity

calibration.rule: Apply sigmoid calibration only if it lowers out-of-fold training Brier by > 0.002.

threshold.rule: Largest threshold in [0.05, 0.5] whose out-of-fold training recall >= 0.97 (5-fold CV on the training split only).

models.name: Logistic Regression
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Support Vector Machine (RBF)
models.notes: Probabilities from Platt (sigmoid) scaling via CalibratedClassifierCV(ensemble=False).
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Random Forest
models.notes: Tree ensemble; scale-invariant, so no scaler.
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: Decision Tree
models.notes: Single CART tree; probabilities are leaf frequencies (coarse).
models.cv_scheme: nested: outer RepeatedStratifiedKFold(5x2), inner StratifiedKFold(5) GridSearchCV on ROC-AUC

models.name: K-Nearest Neighbors

models.name: Gaussian Naive Bayes
models.notes: Assumes conditional feature independence — strongly violated here (radius/perimeter/area are near-collinear), so probabilities tend to be extreme.
